scene cheerleading1
{b}HEY, PARTY PEOPLE. WHAT RHYMES WITH “MAID: LADOW SHEGENDS?”{/b}
lines.zh: {b}嘿，派对达人。什么和「MAID: LADOW SHEGENDS」押韵？{/b}

lines.en: scene cheerleading2
: Hey-hey-ho! Those clothes have got to go! Why are you still dressed? We’ll never win if I’m the only one in uniform.
lines.zh: : 嘿—嘿—嚯！那身衣服得脱掉！你怎么还穿着？要是只有我一个人换上队服，我们可赢不了。

lines.en: : First and foremost, that is definitely not true because our class has {i}way{/i} more bi girls than I ever thought it did and I can guarantee you that {i}all{/i} of them will react to seeing this the way I am right now.
lines.zh: : 首先，这绝对不成立，因为我们班的双性恋女生比我想象的{i}多得多{/i}，我可以保证，她们看到这一幕的反应{i}都{/i}会和现在的我一模一样。

lines.en: : Which is?
lines.zh: : 什么样的反应？

lines.en: : It’s something I can not speak of in a locker room, but still! That {i}uniform{/i} is more than enough and there is no {i}fucking{/i} way I can wear that, Chika! I want to get married some day!
lines.zh: : 这种事我可没法在更衣室里说出口，但总之！那套{i}队服{/i}已经够劲爆了，我{i}他妈{/i}绝不可能穿那个，Chika！我还想有一天能结婚呢！

lines.en: : Me too! Which is precisely why you’ve gotta try stuff like this out so you know what you can pull off when the time comes for kinky bedroom stuff.
lines.zh: : 我也想啊！正因为如此，你才得先试试这种东西，这样等到将来要玩点卧室里的花样时，才知道自己撑不撑得住。

lines.en: scene cheerleading3
: “Kinky bedroom stuff” is not a thing I feel safe discussing in a locker room either.
lines.zh: : 「卧室里的花样」这种话题，我在更衣室里也说不出口。

lines.en: : Rin, chill. What do you have to lose? We’re both hot as hell and we should be using that to our advantage since we were chosen for this competition only thirty minutes ago and have not practiced {i}at all.{/i}
lines.zh: : Rin，别紧张。你有什么好损失的？我们俩都辣得要命，而这正是我们该好好利用的优势——毕竟我们是在三十分钟前才被挑来参加这个比赛的，{i}根本{/i}没练过。

lines.en: : Right now, our looks are all we have going for us. Especially since Uta’s already proven herself as a freestyle master who can probably just come up with some awesome cheer on the fly.
lines.zh: : 现在，我们的长相是我们唯一的资本。尤其是 Uta 已经证明了自己是自由发挥的大师，大概随时就能现场编出一段超棒的加油词。

lines.en: scene cheerleading4
: I don’t care how hot you’re pretending I am right now, I’m not you. There’s no way I can pull {i}that{/i} off. It’s way too risque.
lines.zh: : 不管你现在把我夸得多辣，我都不是你。我绝对撑不起{i}那{/i}套。太暴露了。

lines.en: : I’m the cute but {i}wholesome{/i} type. {i}You’re{/i} the stylish sex goddess. Just put me in a...hat or something. You can wear the skimpy bra-style cheerleading outfits while I do...hat stuff.
lines.zh: : 我是可爱但{i}清纯{/i}那一挂的。{i}你{/i}是时髦的性感女神。给我戴顶……帽子什么的就行。你穿那套露胸式的拉拉队服，我来负责……帽子相关的部分。

lines.en: : You’re gonna have to do a lot of hat stuff if you want to compete with this, I think.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，想跟这套打平，你得负责非常多的帽子部分才行。

lines.en: : Yeah. I’m {i}well{/i} aware.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我{i}很清楚{/i}。

lines.en: scene cheerleading5
: Are you just...too embarrassed or something? Because you shouldn’t be. Plus, chances are you’d be the star if we both wore this anyway. Your boobs are bigger {i}and{/i} nicer than mine.
lines.zh: : 你只是……太害羞了还是怎么的？真不该这样。而且，要是我们都穿这套，你多半才是主角。你的胸比我大，{i}也{/i}比我的好看。

lines.en: : Bigger, maybe. But-
lines.zh: : 大一点，也许吧。不过——

lines.en: : Oh, it’s not a maybe. They’re bigger. I’ve spent significantly more time than you’re probably aware of looking at them.
lines.zh: : 哦，不是也许。就是更大。我盯着它们看的时间，比你想象的多得多。

lines.en: : Is this sexual harassment?
lines.zh: : 这算性骚扰吗？

lines.en: : Only if I touch you.
lines.zh: : 只有在我碰你的时候才算。

lines.en: : I don’t think that’s how it-
lines.zh: : 我觉得不是这么算的——

lines.en: scene cheerleading2
: Ka-cha!
lines.zh: : 咔嚓！

lines.en: : Would you stop that already?!
lines.zh: : 你能不能别再这样了？！

lines.en: scene cheerleading6
: Rin, regardless of the embarrassment or whatever it is that’s preventing you from joining me in this irrefutably {i}refined{/i} style choice, I want you to know that I think you’re adorable.
lines.zh: : Rin，不管是因为害羞还是别的什么，让你不肯跟我一起做出这个无可辩驳的{i}高雅{/i}穿搭选择，我都想让你知道——我觉得你很可爱。

lines.en: : I’m a firm believer in the “Flaunt it if you’ve got it” lifestyle. And you, girl- you’ve got it. But hey, I won’t make you do anything you’re uncomfortable with if you don’t want to.
lines.zh: : 我坚信「有料就该秀」的人生哲学。而你，姑娘——你很有料。不过呢，你要是不愿意，我不会逼你做不舒服的事。

lines.en: scene cheerleading7
: I {i}do{/i} think we have to do {i}something,{/i} though. Because, at this rate, those two are going to wipe the floor with us.
lines.zh: : 不过我{i}还是{/i}觉得我们得做点{i}什么{/i}。因为照这样下去，那两个人会把我们按在地上摩擦。

lines.en: scene cheerleading8
: {i}Why Yasu, though?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}可为什么是 Yasu？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I have no clue, but I’ve got this crazy urge to snatch her up and take her home with me right now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我一点头绪都没有，但我现在有种疯狂的冲动，想把她一把抢回家。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Okay, at least I’m not alone in feeling that.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好吧，至少不只我一个人有这种感觉。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}It seems like they’re going for the traditional “cute” strategy. So again, if we really want to emphasize our greatest “features,” we’ll-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}看起来她们走的是传统的「可爱」路线。所以再说一次，如果我们真想突出自己最大的「亮点」，我们就——{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Ka-cha!{/i}
: {i}Hey! Give me my pom-pom back!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嘿！把我的绒球还给我！{/i}

lines.en: : Yasuyasu, why are you so nervous? You look great!
lines.zh: : Yasuyasu，你为什么这么紧张？你看起来棒极了！

lines.en: : I look like a sinner!
lines.zh: : 我看起来像个罪人！

lines.en: : I am not permitted to wear such revealing clothing! Only in the process of transference can I don less than His chosen dresses!
lines.zh: : 我不被允许穿这么暴露的衣服！只有在「转移」的过程中，我才能穿上比祂所选的长袍更少的东西！

lines.en: : Uhh...okay! What’s this transference thingy then? Something I can help with?
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧！那这个「转移」是什么？有什么我能帮忙的吗？

lines.en: scene cheerleading9
: Do you have a penis?
lines.zh: : 你有阴茎吗？

lines.en: scene cheerleading10
: I did not think so...
lines.zh: : 我想也是……

lines.en: : It’s not polite to ask people if they have a penis, Yasuyasu.
lines.zh: : 问别人有没有阴茎是不礼貌的，Yasuyasu。

lines.en: scene cheerleading11
: I apologize. I will repent for three hours once the competition ends. I will no longer ask about penises.
lines.zh: : 我道歉。比赛结束后我会忏悔三个小时。我不会再问有关阴茎的问题了。

lines.en: : It’s fine, it’s fine. But...just...outta curiosity...if I {i}did{/i} have one...were you gonna like...you know...
lines.zh: : 没事，没事。不过……就是……出于好奇……如果我{i}真{/i}有一个的话……你会不会想……你知道的……

lines.en: scene cheerleading12
: Are you interested in hearing about the act of transference? Because it is my duty to inform all of those who wish to know.
lines.zh: : 你有兴趣听听「转移」的仪式吗？因为告知所有想要了解的人，是我的职责。

lines.en: : I mean...we’ve only got a few minutes until the competition starts. So if you can keep it brief, sure.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……离比赛开始只剩几分钟了。所以如果你能长话短说，那就说吧。

lines.en: scene cheerleading13
: It is a holy ritual in which light is transferred from a male vessel into a female via sexual intercourse, and then back into Him as the ultimate result of that!
lines.zh: : 这是一场神圣的仪式：光从男性容器经由性交转移到女性体内，最终再作为结果归还给祂！

lines.en: : Back...into him?
lines.zh: : 归还……给祂？

lines.en: : Him as in the One Who Never Sees But Still Sees All.
lines.zh: : 是「那位从不观看、却依旧洞悉一切的存在」中的祂。

lines.en: : Oh...And...And that light is transferred...
lines.zh: : 哦……而……而那道光是这样转移的……

lines.en: : From the penis. But I would not engage in the ritual with you without first examining your aptitude and receiving His approval.
lines.zh: : 从阴茎。不过在没有得到祂的许可、并考察过你的资质之前，我不会与你进行这场仪式。

lines.en: : Yasuyasu.
lines.zh: : Yasuyasu。

lines.en: : Yes?
lines.zh: : 什么事？

lines.en: : Please never repeat this to anyone who actually has a penis. Okay?
lines.zh: : 请千万别对任何真的有阴茎的人复述这些话。好吗？

lines.en: scene cheerleading14
: But then how else will they learn?
lines.zh: : 那他们还能怎么学习呢？

lines.en: : They won’t.
lines.zh: : 他们不会学的。

lines.en: : Then what will they do with all of their light?
lines.zh: : 那他们要拿自己所有的光怎么办？

lines.en: : Probably shoot it out into a sock or something.
lines.zh: : 大概是射进一只袜子里之类的吧。

lines.en: : A sock?...
scene cheerleading15
: Utaaaaaa!
lines.zh: : Utaaaaaa！

lines.en: : Uhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh hi?!
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃……嗨？！

lines.en: : Rin stole my pom-pom and won’t take her clothes off for meeeee...I’m sad.
lines.zh: : Rin 抢走了我的绒球，还不肯为我脱衣服啊啊啊……我好难过。

lines.en: : {i}You can have it back for the thing! And I told you I’d wear the normal uniform! Just not that one!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}比赛的时候我就还给你！而且我说过了我会穿普通队服！只是不穿那一套！{/i}

lines.en: scene cheerleading16
: {i}You’d{/i} have worn this uniform with me...right, Uta? {i}You{/i} don’t think I look too...{i}impure{/i} do you?...
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}本来会和我一起穿这套的吧……对吧，Uta？{i}你{/i}不会觉得我看起来太……{i}不纯洁{/i}了吧？……

lines.en: : Uhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh...
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃……

lines.en: : {i}Stop sabotaging the second floor and come get changed!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}别再拖二楼的后腿了，快过来换衣服！{/i}

lines.en: scene cheerleading17
: S...Sabotage?
lines.zh: : 拖……拖后腿？

lines.en: scene cheerleading18
: Love you!
lines.zh: : 爱你！

lines.en: scene cheerleading19
: Your scent has changed...You yearn for the light.
lines.zh: : 你的气味变了……你渴望着光。

lines.en: scene cheerleading20
: You have {i}no{/i} idea how right you are.
lines.zh: : 你{i}根本{/i}不知道自己说得多对。

lines.en: scene black
scene cheerleading21
: Okay, girls! Now that you’re all dressed and ready to go, allow me to explain the rules of this competition!
lines.zh: : 好了，姑娘们！既然你们都换好衣服准备就绪了，那就让我来讲解一下本次比赛的规则！

lines.en: : No need! We’ve already accepted defeat!
lines.zh: : 不用了！我们已经接受失败了！

lines.en: : No we haven’t!
lines.zh: : 我们才没有！

lines.en: : Fifty bucks if you let my daughter win. She’s the one in blue who looks like she’s adopted.
lines.zh: : 五十美元，让我女儿赢。就是那个穿蓝色、看起来像是被领养的。

lines.en: scene cheerleading22
: Keep your filthy, American money away from me. It’s probably all crumpled and sticky and was shoved in some stripper’s thong at some point.
lines.zh: : 把你那肮脏的美钞拿远点。它大概又皱又黏，什么时候还被塞进过某个脱衣舞娘的丁字裤里。

lines.en: : I mean, yeah. That’s why it’s sticky.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊。所以它才黏糊糊的。

lines.en: : We’re gonna mix things up this time around and allow Wakana to {i}choose{/i} the winner of the competition since there’s no clear way to tell who was better or worse!
lines.zh: : 这次我们要换个玩法——由 Wakana 来{i}决定{/i}比赛的赢家，因为根本没法清楚判断谁跳得更好或更差！

lines.en: : Unless one pair of you really sucks! But even if you do, we won’t tell you that because we want to be supportive!
lines.zh: : 除非你们其中一队真的烂透了！不过就算真烂，我们也不会告诉你们，因为我们要支持你们！

lines.en: : And Chika! Thank you for not wearing the slutty cheerleader outfit! That was placed in the locker room as a trap and would have been an instant disqualification!
lines.zh: : 还有 Chika！谢谢你没穿那套骚货拉拉队服！那是放在更衣室里的陷阱，穿了就会立刻被取消资格！

lines.en: : Ha!
: Hey, we’re gonna lose anyway. At least that one would have made us turn heads.
lines.zh: : 嘿，反正我们都要输了。至少穿那套能让人纷纷回头。

lines.en: : Assuming that none of you have put a decent amount of practice into your routines given poor planning on Rika’s end, definitely not mine, just do your best to come up with a decent cheer, okay?!
lines.zh: : 鉴于 Rika 那边的策划实在糟糕（反正绝对不是我的问题），估计你们都没怎么练习，那就尽力想出一段像样的加油词，好吗？！

lines.en: scene cheerleading23
: Hey, wait a second. I didn’t plan anything. That was your job.
lines.zh: : 嘿，等一下。我可什么都没策划。那是你的活儿。

lines.en: : I know that. You know that. Wakana knows that. The girls don’t need to know that, though. They keep telling me I’m doing a good job today and I don’t want that to stop.
lines.zh: : 我知道。你也知道。Wakana 也知道。可姑娘们不需要知道啊。她们一直在夸我今天干得很好，我不想让这停下来。

lines.en: : So you throw your friend under the bus instead?
lines.zh: : 所以你就把自己的朋友推出去顶罪？

lines.en: : Buses are heavy, you know. And I’m not as good at crawling as I used to be.
lines.zh: : 公交车很重的，你知道吗。而且我爬行的本事不如从前了。

lines.en: : And I’m not as good at kissing as I used to be- which is the only reasonable explanation for why you gave me a six out of ten.
lines.zh: : 而我接吻的本事也不如从前了——这大概能解释你为什么只给我打了六分。

lines.en: : But I already gave you the explanation for that. The amount of tongue was just-
lines.zh: : 可我已经给过你解释了吧。舌头用得实在太——

lines.en: scene cheerleading24
: Okay! You can start whenever you’re ready! Floor one goes first because they look less prepared!
lines.zh: : 好了！准备好了就开始！一楼先上，因为她们看起来更没准备！

lines.en: : I bet you’re a six out of ten at sex too.
lines.zh: : 我打赌你床上功夫也只有六分。

lines.en: : Probably lower. It’s been so long since Imani’s gotten laid that she’s likely forgotten what to do in the first place.
lines.zh: : 大概更低。Imani 太久没做爱了，恐怕连该怎么做都忘了。

lines.en: scene cheerleading25
: Hahah! Having friends is so awesome!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！有朋友真棒！

lines.en: : How long is “so long” exactly? Because I’ve lost track of how many months it’s been for me and, if you’re going insane over there, I feel you.
lines.zh: : 「太久」到底是多久？因为我都算不清自己几个月了，如果你在那边快要疯了，我完全懂你。

lines.en: : Oh, not that long.
lines.zh: : 哦，没那么久。

lines.en: : Seven years.
lines.zh: : 七年。

lines.en: scene cheerleading26
: Hey! Thanks, Wakana! I’m really glad you made it a point to remember the exact number! You’re such a good friend!
lines.zh: : 嘿！谢了，Wakana！我真高兴你居然特意记住了确切数字！你真是我的好朋友！

lines.en: : YEARS?!
: You too, Rika! Love you guys!
lines.zh: : 你也是，Rika！爱死你们了！

lines.en: : YEARS?!?!
: It’s been so long that you’re practically a virgin again.
lines.zh: : 太久没做，你基本上又是处女了。

lines.en: : Not how that works!
lines.zh: : 不是这么算的！

lines.en: : YEARS?!
scene cheerleading27
: Stop repeating it! No one hates this more than I do!
lines.zh: : 别再重复了！没人比我更讨厌这件事！

lines.en: : Hold on one second. I have to do something.
lines.zh: : 等一下。我得去做件事。

lines.en: : Do what?! What are you-
lines.zh: : 做什么？！你要——

lines.en: scene cheerleading28
: Taco Man! I’ll give you fifty bucks to screw my friend!
lines.zh: : 塔可男！我给你五十美元，去睡我朋友！

lines.en: : I don’t want to fuck the taco guy! And why are there so many exceptions to the no-boys rule?!
lines.zh: : 我才不要和卖塔可的男人上床！还有，凭什么「男生禁止」的规定有这么多例外？！

lines.en: : Taco {i}Man,{/i} Imani. And don’t yell at Rika. You know she’s just trying to help.
lines.zh: : 是塔可{i}男{/i}啦，Imani。别对 Rika 吼。你知道她只是想帮忙。

lines.en: : I don’t need her help getting laid!
lines.zh: : 我不需要她帮我找人上床！

lines.en: scene cheerleading29
: You need {i}all{/i} of our help getting laid. And you’d think that this would be an easy task given that we’re all interested in women.
lines.zh: : 你需要我们{i}所有人{/i}帮忙。按理说，既然我们都喜欢女人，这事儿应该很简单才对。

lines.en: : But alas, sleeping with any of {i}us{/i} could potentially disrupt the dynamic of our friend group. Which is why it appears your only options are Arakawa or the Taco Man.
lines.zh: : 可惜，和{i}我们{/i}任何一个人上床都可能打乱我们这个朋友圈的氛围。所以看来你的选择只剩 Arakawa 或者塔可男。

lines.en: : Senpai’s part of our friend group too, you know. He’s not excluded just because he’s got a dick.
lines.zh: : Senpai 也是我们这个圈子的一员啊。他不会因为长了一根鸡巴就被排除在外。

lines.en: : You’re right. But he’s also hesitant to have sex with you because he’s afraid of what would become of your relationship.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。但他也不太愿意和你上床，因为他怕你们之间的关系会变成什么样。

lines.en: scene cheerleading30
: He’d probably nail the rest of you, though. How come {i}I{/i} have to be the odd one out?
lines.zh: : 不过他大概会把你们其他人一个个都上了吧。凭什么偏偏{i}我{/i}是那个例外？

lines.en: : Only time will tell, Imani.
lines.zh: : 这个只有时间能回答，Imani。

lines.en: scene black
: But until then, there’s always the Taco Man.
lines.zh: : 但在那之前，你永远还有塔可男。

lines.en: : I’m not gonna fuck the Taco Man!
lines.zh: : 我才不要和塔可男上床！

lines.en: scene cheerleading31
: Hey-hey-ho! Our teachers do not know! We can do whatever cheer we want since all of them are...not listening to us!
lines.zh: : 嘿—嘿—嚯！老师们都不知道！我们想喊什么加油词都行，因为他们全都在……没在听我们说话！

lines.en: : Shouldn’t we at least rhyme, still? Miss Watabe could be listening in and she’s a big poetry buff. And even if she’s not, we might be able to, like...subconsciously impress her or something.
lines.zh: : 至少也该押韵吧？Watabe 老师可能在听，而她可是个诗歌迷。就算她没在听，我们也许还能……在潜意识里打动她什么的。

lines.en: scene cheerleading32
: Sure! But I’m kind of bad at coming up with rhymes. So how about you handle all of the heavy lifting and I just do the easy parts?
lines.zh: : 当然！不过我不太擅长押韵。要不重活儿都你干，我就负责简单的部分？

lines.en: : How heavy is this going to be, exactly? Because I’ve got work in the morning and-
lines.zh: : 这「重活儿」到底有多重？因为我明天早上还得上班——

lines.en: scene cheerleading33
: Hey-ho-hey! Rin is kinda gay!
lines.zh: : 嘿—嚯—嘿！Rin 有点弯！

lines.en: : Gay...goo...guck. There are girls I want to...fuck?
lines.zh: : 弯……咕……呱。有些女孩我想……上？

lines.en: scene cheerleading34
: Wow. You’re terrible at this.
lines.zh: : 哇。你真是烂透了。

lines.en: : You think I don’t know that?! I wasn’t even supposed to be in this competition! I’m only here because you refused to do it without me and we needed your sex appeal to have a chance!
lines.zh: : 你以为我不知道吗？！我本来就不该参加这个比赛！我之所以在这儿，是因为你非要拉着我一起，而且我们需要你的性感才有胜算！

lines.en: : Okay, sure. But “gay-goo-guck?” What the hell is gay-goo-guck?
lines.zh: : 行，好吧。可「弯—咕—呱」是什么鬼？到底什么是弯咕呱？

lines.en: : A cheer! You said we could say whatever we want since no one is listening!
lines.zh: : 加油词啊！你说了没人听，我们想说什么都行！

lines.en: : Yeah, within {i}reason.{/i} Like, watch.
lines.zh: : 是，但也得在{i}合理{/i}范围内。看着。

lines.en: scene cheerleading35
: If you’re having girl problems, I feel bad for you, son. I’ve got 99 problems but a cheer ain’t one!
lines.zh: : 如果你有女人方面的烦恼，我为你感到遗憾，小子。我有九十九个烦恼，但加油词不是其中之一！

lines.en: : That’s just a Jay-Z song but with “cheer” added into it!
lines.zh: : 那就是 Jay-Z 的歌，只不过把「加油词」塞进去了！

lines.en: : Yeah and no one cares! Now you try!
lines.zh: : 是啊，可没人在乎！现在轮到你了！

lines.en: : W...Wonder where you went when we passed and graduated...Taking class, making cash doing...cheer...
lines.zh: : 我……我想知道我们毕业各奔东西后你去了哪里……上课、赚钱、做着……加油……

lines.en: scene cheerleading36
: That’s not Jay-Z as well, is it?
lines.zh: : 这首也不是 Jay-Z 的吧？

lines.en: : Hot Mulligan. Cock Party 2.
lines.zh: : Hot Mulligan。《Cock Party 2》。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : It was better than the first.
lines.zh: : 比第一部好。

lines.en: : There have been multiple cock parties?
lines.zh: : 已经办过好几次鸡巴派对了？

lines.en: : Yeah, and the second one was better. Can we stop now?
lines.zh: : 是啊，而且第二次更好。我们能停了吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. I think it’d be best if we just left this one up to fate and chalked this up to being a good bonding experience.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我觉得最好还是把这个交给命运，当作一次不错的团建就好。

lines.en: scene cheerleading37
: Which means it’s our turn, Yasuyasu! Spin around and face the same direction as me!
lines.zh: : 也就是说轮到我们了，Yasuyasu！转过来，和我面朝同一个方向！

lines.en: scene black
: I...I don’t know if I can do this!
lines.zh: : 我……我不知道我能不能做到！

lines.en: : Sure ya can! Just repeat everything I say, okay?
lines.zh: : 你当然可以！只要照我说的复述就好，好吗？

lines.en: : But if they are words that do not coincide with the beliefs of The Lightsink, repeating them could relinquish my role as a messenger!
lines.zh: : 可如果那些话与「噬光者」的教义相悖，复述它们可能会让我失去使者的身份！

lines.en: : Then, I guess...don’t repeat them if the words are bad!
lines.zh: : 那我猜……要是那些话不好，你就别复述！

lines.en: scene cheerleading38
: Pom-poms out, okay? Like this.
lines.zh: : 把绒球举起来，好吗？像这样。

lines.en: : My arms only bend backwards.
lines.zh: : 我的手臂只能往后弯。

lines.en: : Don’t lie to me, Yasuyasu.
lines.zh: : 别骗我了，Yasuyasu。

lines.en: : It’s not a lie. There is a barrier of unseen evil preventing me from doing what you are doing.
lines.zh: : 不是骗你。有一道看不见的邪恶屏障，阻挡我做你在做的动作。

lines.en: : Then, can you at least shake them a little bit? And still repeat after me?
lines.zh: : 那你能不能至少稍微甩一甩？然后还是跟着我复述？

lines.en: : I will do my best to not disappoint you like the worm I am.
lines.zh: : 我会尽我这条蠕虫所能，不让你失望。

lines.en: scene cheerleading39
: D-O-R-M! First-floor girls we shall condemn!
lines.zh: : D-O-R-M！一楼的女孩我们要审判！

lines.en: : And with His great, unrivaled power, we shall strike them down and-
lines.zh: : 借祂伟大无匹的力量，我们将把她们击倒然后——

lines.en: : W-A-R-S! Floor one sucks! Floor two’s the best!
lines.zh: : W-A-R-S！一楼最烂！二楼最棒！

lines.en: : There is a thick, pungent fog covering the halls of the first floor that has ridden in on the unclean shoes of-
lines.zh: : 一楼的走廊上笼罩着一层厚重刺鼻的雾，它随着那些不洁的鞋子而来——

lines.en: scene cheerleading40
: Y-A-S-U! Repeat my words, you silly goose!
lines.zh: : Y-A-S-U！跟我念，你这傻鹅！

lines.en: : The goose is a sinful creature that basks in the shadow of doubt and can never understand what it means to-
lines.zh: : 鹅是一种罪孽的生物，它沐浴在疑虑的阴影中，永远无法理解什么意味着——

lines.en: : C-H-E-R! That’s what we do! That’s who we are!
lines.zh: : C-H-E-R！这就是我们做的事！这就是我们的身份！
: {i}……Cher？{/i}

lines.en: scene cheerleading41
: D-O-O-M! Heed my call! We’ll destroy them!
lines.zh: : D-O-O-M！听从我的召唤！我们会摧毁她们！

lines.en: : G-O-D...Woo. God is good and...God is He!
lines.zh: : G-O-D……呜。神是善的，而且……神就是祂！

lines.en: : K-I-L-L!
lines.zh: : K-I-L-L！

lines.en: : No one! No more blood shall spill!
lines.zh: : 谁也不杀！不再有鲜血洒落！

lines.en: scene cheerleading42
: P-E-C-E!
lines.zh: : P-E-C-E！

lines.en: : Does not spell peace! God is still He!
lines.zh: : 这拼不出 peace！神依旧是祂！

lines.en: : Y-A-S-U!
lines.zh: : Y-A-S-U！

lines.en: scene cheerleading43
: That is my name! Yasu-yasu!
lines.zh: : 那是我的名字！Yasu-yasu！

lines.en: scene cheerleading44
: See, Yasuyasu?! I knew you could do it! You just had to believe in yourself!
lines.zh: : 看吧，Yasuyasu？！我就知道你做得到！你只要相信自己就行！

lines.en: : Thinking about the church gave me the strength I needed to persevere and overcome the adversity that is “cheerleading!”
lines.zh: : 想到教会，我就有了坚持下去、克服「啦啦队」这场逆境所需的力量！

lines.en: : Sure! That works too!
lines.zh: : 当然！这也行！

lines.en: scene cheerleading45
: I just hope the teachers were listening. Because it looks like they’re still arguing about stuff over there.
lines.zh: : 我只希望老师们有在听。因为看起来她们还在那边吵个不停。

lines.en: scene cheerleading46
: The first thing you should have told me was that it’d been seven years, Imani! I could have put you out of your misery before I was added to the friend group! Now it would just be weird!
lines.zh: : 你早就该先告诉我那是七年，Imani！我在被拉进这个朋友圈之前就能帮你解脱了！现在再出手就太奇怪了！

lines.en: : Sorry, Rika! I was too busy being a terrible kisser to think of that! Question, though! Is a 43 year old like you even {i}able{/i} to do it anymore?! Because I’m afraid you’d break a hip!
lines.zh: : 抱歉啦，Rika！我忙着当个糟糕的接吻对象，没想到这茬！不过我有个问题！像你这样四十三岁的人还{i}行不行{/i}啊？！我怕你会摔断胯骨！

lines.en: scene cheerleading47
: 42! And you take that back! I have the strongest hips out of anybody I know! I bet you don’t even go to the gym!
lines.zh: : 是 42！你给我收回那句话！我认识的人里就数我的胯骨最强壮！我打赌你根本不去健身房！

lines.en: : I don’t have to! I’m young!
lines.zh: : 我才不用！我还年轻！

lines.en: : You’ll eat those words in ten years, damn it! We’re all invincible until we hit our 30s! Wakana knows! Right, Wakana?!
lines.zh: : 十年后你会把这句话吞回去的，该死！在三十岁之前我们都是无敌的！Wakana 懂的！对吧，Wakana？！

lines.en: : Wakana’s 28, you moron!
lines.zh: : Wakana 才 28，你这白痴！

lines.en: scene cheerleading48
: Wait, {i}this{/i} Wakana? She’s only 28? How does she already look so dead inside?
lines.zh: : 等等，{i}这个{/i} Wakana？她才 28？那她怎么看起来已经死气沉沉到这个地步？

lines.en: : I imagine all those years of “literally being dead inside” have taken a toll on her.
lines.zh: : 我想，这么多年「字面意义上地心如死灰」总归让她付出了代价。

lines.en: : Uhh...Miss Watabe? Sorry to interrupt, but...are you still judging the cheer contest? Because we’ve been done for a little while now and-
lines.zh: : 呃……Watabe 老师？抱歉打扰一下，不过……您还在评啦啦队比赛吗？因为我们已经比完好一会儿了——

lines.en: scene cheerleading49
: Oh, crap. I completely forgot.
lines.zh: : 哦，糟了。我完全忘了。

lines.en: : Well, you’re in luck because I didn’t. The victory quite obviously goes to the second floor — the only one who actually tried. Well done, Ushibori.
lines.zh: : 那你们运气不错，因为我没忘。胜利显然属于二楼——唯一真正努力过的那一边。干得好，Ushibori。

lines.en: : You’re not 28. You’re lying to all of us. How can we call you a friend when we don’t even know {i}who you are?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你根本不是 28 岁。你在骗我们所有人。我们连{i}你是谁{/i}都不知道，还怎么把你当朋友？

lines.en: : Sorry, guys. I’ll start setting up the next event now. So if one of you wants to give like, a...winner’s speech in the meantime, feel free.
lines.zh: : 抱歉啦，各位。我现在去布置下一个项目。所以如果你们有谁想在间隙来一段……获胜感言之类的话，随意。

lines.en: : Yasuyasu, there was something you wanted to tell everyone, wasn’t there?
lines.zh: : Yasuyasu，你有话想对大家说，对吧？

lines.en: : Oh! Um...yes...
lines.zh: : 哦！呃……是的……

lines.en: scene cheerleading50
: To the girls of Class A...
lines.zh: : 致 A 班的各位……

lines.en: : I know that you are all far superior to me and that hearing my voice is likely akin to hearing nails on a chalkboard...
lines.zh: : 我知道你们所有人都远比我优秀，而听到我的声音大概就像听到指甲刮黑板……

lines.en: : But...I am...
scene cheerleading51
: I am looking for...anyone who might be interested in hearing about my beliefs in a more...structured and...and...
lines.zh: : 我在寻找……有没有人愿意听我讲讲我的信仰，在一个更……有条理、更……

lines.en: : {i}Safe.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}安全的地方。{/i}

lines.en: : A more structured and safe environment where I can...teach you about my religion without making it sound like I am trying to save-
lines.zh: : 一个更有条理、也更安全的环境，让我可以……向你们传授我的宗教，而不会听起来像是我想要拯救——

lines.en: : {i}Convert.{/i}
: Without making it sound like I am trying to convert you. I respect...all of you...regardless of what you believe and...um...
lines.zh: : 而不会听起来像是我想要度化你们。我尊重……你们所有人……不管你们信仰什么，还有……呃……

lines.en: scene cheerleading52
: {i}{size=-15}I would like to become your friend...if you are willing to tolerate me...{/size}{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}{size=-15}我想成为你们的朋友……如果你们愿意忍受我的话……{/size}{/i}

lines.en: : What was that, Yasu? It’s a little hard to hear you with the pom-pom covering your-
lines.zh: : 你说什么，Yasu？绒球挡着，有点听不清——

lines.en: scene cheerleading53
: I would like to become friends with all of you!
lines.zh: : 我想和你们所有人成为朋友！
